spiders.title: Everyone's a Feminist Until There Is a Spider Around:
spiders.text: Defeat twenty [[Spider]] enemies. Keep track with tally marks in your Campaign Log. (Note: swarm cards do not count.)

carter_method.title: The Carter Method
carter_method.text: Let every location get infested, then seal all of them in Waking Nightmare.

doctor_is_in.title: The Doctor is In
doctor_is_in.text: Take Dr. Shivani Maheswaran with you and do not let her take any amount of damage or horror in Waking Nightmare.

deja_vu.title: Déjà Vu
deja_vu.text: Resolve every free triggered ability on every location in A Thousand Shapes of Horror (not counting the Mysterious Stairs during act 2).

casa_loma.title: The Casa Loma Maneuver
casa_loma.text: Escape the endless stairs with The Unnamable at the topmost staircase in A Thousand Shapes of Horror.

remember_this_place.title: I Remember This Place
remember_this_place.text: Find a way out of the Underworld in Point of No Return.

bad_advice.title: Bad Advice
bad_advice.text: Flip over every location at least once in Point of No Return.

march_of_ghouls.title: March of the Ghouls
march_of_ghouls.text: Have 4 [[Ghoul]] enemies attached to Richard Upton Pickman in Point of No Return.

ishimura.title: The Ishimura Flex
ishimura.text: In a single round, defeat all 4 Legs of Atlach-Nacha in Weaver of the Cosmos.

spin_me_round.title: You Spin Me Right 'Round:
spin_me_round.text: Ensure that Atlach-Nacha spins a full 360 degrees in a single phase in Weaver of the Cosmos.

master_of_unlocking.title: Master of Unlocking
master_of_unlocking.text: Use The Silver Key to cancel a total of at least 10 horror throughout the course of a single scenario.

line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Web of Dreams campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

underworld_expertise.title: Underworld Expertise
underworld_expertise.text: Win the The Web of Dreams campaign on Expert difficulty.
